Retry ownership

Retry policy belongs at the API client boundary so callers do not multiply attempts independently. Read source guidance.

Pause & recall

Which boundary owns retry policy?

Answer: The API client boundary.

Central ownership prevents nested retries from multiplying attempts.

Apply the model

A controller times out calling an API client. Where should retry limits be enforced?

Shared API client. Per-controller retries compound and hide the true attempt budget.
